notes.title: Testing patch 1.0.6 notes
notes.content:
VFX added:

[list]
[*] Muzzle flash for cannons, scatterguns and Gattling guns
[*] Bullet trail for cannons and scatterguns projectiles
[*] Actual flame for the Flamethrower
[*] Camera shake when shooting with projectile weapons (flamethrower is not affected)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone! o/

This patch features:

[list]
[*] A little scaled up enemies - for better visibility
[*] Enemies accuracy bias depending on the difficulty settings
[*] Camera zoom - use the mouse scroll or gamepad left up/down buttons to zoom in or out
[*] Dynamic enemy markers - the red enemy markers now scale and have opacity based on the between you and the enemy drone. This should help you tell which ones are closer or farther relative to your position
[*] Radar - there's a radar which points you towards enemy locations now. This should help determine faster where the enemies are situated
[/list]

Looking forward for any feedback you have! <3

notes.title: Build 0.3.18 RC
notes.content:
Few changes:
[list]
[*] AI can now run away from conflict for some time.
[*] Projectiles are faster.
[*] Flamethrower got some love.
[*] Enemy hitboxes are slightly larger.
[*] Collectible pick-up range is increased, as well as their scale so they can be more visible from afar. Increased range means other drones can get them easier too though.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.3.16RC (release candidate) deploy
notes.content: Fixed some more bugs and added "How to play" instructions as well as a "Credits" screen.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.14
notes.content: This patch brings some bug fixes, better UI visibility and MUSIC! \o/

notes.title: Update 0.3.12
notes.content:
Some patch notes:

[list]
[*] New map
[*] Graphics optimization
[*] Added more wave info during gameplay on HUD and mid game card selection screen
[*] Added weapon descriptions on end game card selection
[*] Fixed a bug with projectiles where they would sometimes go through solid objects
[*] Fixed some graphics bugs with mid game card selection screen
[*] Adjusted rocket launchers reload times
[*] AI will now stop chasing and look for another target when an obstacle is in the way instead of bumping into it.
[/list]
